name: video-creative-rules
summary: Creative rules and gates for a short video cut: plan rubric, reading-time floor with a checker, beat and audio policy, delivery gates and a tone preset per brief workflow. Owned by the Video Studio repository; this copy tracks its released skill.
triggers: how long should on-screen text hold in a video
beat sync the reveals in a video
normalize the loudness of a render
pick the poster frame for a video
exclusions: choosing a final or approving a preference
editing footage or a timeline directly
side_effects: local file writes in the project's working folder
local ffmpeg audio re-encode of a delivered render
